name: s-restaurant-pos
description: S Restaurant — offline-first restaurant POS (orders, KOT/KDS, billing, inventory, reports) for Windows.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "wait-on http://localhost:5205 backend/dist/main.js && electron backend/dist/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/build-windows-portable.mjs
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
